title: How to plan a revision week
excerpt: A simple plan for the week before exams.
content:
Start with a list of every topic.

## Make a timetable

Give each topic **two short sessions**, a few days apart.

title: Why sleep helps you learn
content: Your brain sorts what you learned while you sleep. The average of $n$ scores is $\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum x_i$.
